name: Dual Access Gradient Quantization
aliases: Dual access gradient quantization data structure
definition: A data structure and algorithm for gradient quantization that allows fast access to quantized gradients using either an integer index or an arbitrary normalized vector, minimizing inner product calculations for silhouette and shading.
summary: Dual Access Gradient Quantization is a data structure that accelerates volume rendering by storing quantized gradient indices in 2 bytes per voxel, enabling fast lookup for both pre-computed and arbitrary vectors.
